concepts.title: Functions of Clothing
concepts.definition: Clothing works on three fronts: protection from weather, injury and hazards; modesty as society defines it; and communication -- status, role, occasion and personality announced through dress. Decorative enhancement runs alongside these as people use clothes for beauty.
concepts.key_idea: Clothes shield, cover and speak -- protection, modesty, communication and adornment in one garment.

solution_steps.explain: Clothes buffer heat, cold, rain, dust and physical hazards for the wearer.
Dress expresses modesty norms, status, occupation, group membership and mood.
Colour, texture and style let people beautify themselves -- the decorative function alongside the rest.

concepts.title: Factors Influencing Selection of Clothes
concepts.definition: What people choose to wear is decided jointly by age and body build, climate and season, occasion and activity, fashion trends, income and the care the garment will need. Psychological factors -- conformity and individuality -- pull the choice in opposite directions at once.
concepts.key_idea: Every purchase is a compromise -- body, climate, occasion, money, fashion and care all file their claims.
concepts.textbook_ref: kehe202.txt selection sections (factors influencing selection, age climate occasion fashion income care, conformity and individuality)
question_patterns: discuss the factors that influence selection of clothes

solution_steps.explain: Body size, climate, occasion, activity and budget impose hard constraints on choice.
Fashion, taste, conformity to peers and desire for individuality shape what feels right to wear.
A garment's washing, storage and maintenance needs must fit the wearer's resources, or the choice fails in practice.

concepts.title: Clothing Needs Across Ages: Children, Teens and Elders
concepts.definition: Clothing needs shift across the life span: infants want soft, washable, safe fabrics without tight trims; children need tough, free-for-play clothes; adolescents chase fashion and fit; elders prize easy opening, warm layers and comfort. Each stage pairs its physiological realities with its social expectations.
concepts.key_idea: Dress follows development -- softness for infants, sturdiness for children, style for teens, ease for elders.
concepts.textbook_ref: kehe202.txt age sections (clothing needs of infants children adolescents adults elderly, safety in infant clothing, ease of dressing)

solution_steps.explain: Choose soft, absorbent, flame-safe, easily washed garments with no choking trims or tight elastics.
Children need durable, unrestricted play clothes; adolescents add fit, style and peer approval.
Front openings, light warm layers, non-slip footwear and easy care dominate the elderly wardrobe.

worked_examples.question_pattern: A nurse wears a white uniform with identification badge. Identify the clothing functions at work in this dress.

solution_template.explain: The uniform shields against spills and contamination in hospital settings.
White plus badge announces role, institution and authority -- patients read it instantly.
The dress code satisfies professional modesty and decorum expected in care settings.

worked_examples.question_pattern: A grandmother complains a frock bought for her granddaughter is 'useless'. The frock is silky with beaded straps. Judge the purchase using the chapter's criteria.

solution_template.explain: Children need sturdy, washable, unrestricted clothing for play -- beaded silk fails on all three.
Beads and straps pose choking and scratch hazards for small children.
The purchase ignored age-appropriate criteria; the grandmother's complaint is developmentally sound.
